findings.claim: The plugin now always passes --agent to the skill-paths verb, with no capability guard. The plugin runs the engine binary at LABDRIAN_ENGINE_BINARY or ~/.claude/bin/gentle-ai-overlay (lines 192-213). That binary is deployed separately by install-hooks, not by `runtime install/update`, which writes the plugin. After `runtime update --target opencode` installs plugin 2026-11-20-runtime-parity-18, a deployed engine from before this commit still exits 1 with 'unknown flag "--agent"'. resolveSkillPaths turns every failure into a Tool.Error, so every OpenCode subagent launch whose input has a non-empty agent field is denied until install-hooks is re-run. The `skills_root` absence check handled an older install; no equivalent exists for this flag. No test covers a verb that rejects --agent. The Risk line names this case.
